text.tspan: Assay evidence needed to support the biological claim
Saved measurements are available; analytical identity, assay conditions and repeat type need documentation.
LOD / LOQ and relevant raw analytical traces.
Six values under two date labels;
mean and sample SD are reproducible.
Independent reactions and a prospective panel
with predeﬁned success and comparison rules.
The CSV alone does not establish analytical identity, biological replication or isolated catalytic turnover.
